        with open('./tasks.json', 'r') as f:

        print(f"Found {len(data)} tasks to import")
        
        # Import each task
        for i, item in enumerate(data):
            title = item.get('title', f'Task {item.get("id", i)}')
            description = item.get('description', '')
            
            # Create the task
